summary.name: Voicery
summary.one_liner: Voicery was a enterprise text-to-speech company that built custom TTS engines and brand voices; the page states it shut down in October 2020 and its TTS services are disabled.
use_cases: create a custom brand voice for a business
narrate audiobooks or podcasts with synthesized voice
add speech output to apps or devices
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Voicery as a provider of custom text-to-speech engines and brand voices aimed at enterprises. Listed capabilities include voices with accents and emotions, cloud, on-premise, offline, or hybrid deployment, real-time streaming audio, SSML markup for audio adjustments, and embedding synthesized content in pre-recorded audio. Its custom voice process covers voice talent and script scoping, studio recording, and audio processing, followed by deployment on platforms or devices. A pricing block lists $0.001 per character and tiers with features such as request rate limits, bulk discounts, and an on-device synthesis SDK, but the page also states the service has shut down.
notable: Custom voices with accents and emotions built with deep learning
Cloud, on-premise, offline, or hybrid deployment
Real-time streaming audio with SSML markup support
caveats: Voicery shut down in October 2020 and its text-to-speech services are disabled.
Listed pricing was $0.001 per character, which is no longer available.
Custom voice creation was enterprise-oriented and required working directly with the Voicery team.
